g.text: s_zc = a . LeakyReLU(Wq u_z + Wk k_c + w_p p_zc + w_a |p_zc|)

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #111111

g.text: alpha_zc = softmax over the constraints z is exposed to

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #111111

g.text: m_z = sum_c alpha_zc (Wv k_c + v_p p_zc)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111111

g.text: update, then the L4 zone blocks

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #111111

g.text: u_z <- u_z + Drop(Linear(m_z)) * g_z (g_z = 0: no message)

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #111111

g.text: inserted at the node_update hook, before the 2 GATv2 blocks

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: Only the 12 Core zones receive messages; non-Core zones, pretrain days (before 2022-06-09) and days without a published domain get none.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: The interconnector blocks then pass the information on to non-Core neighbours. Control: L4 interconnects + curves, fine-tuned monthly.
